# Number / "Male", "Female" / Diagnosis ICD-10 pattern(s) or NULL

# custom_filter <- list(include_any("drug", atc, "A10BA02"), exclude_any("cancer"))

data_dir       <- "synthetic_cdm_run1_copy"   #insert file path
reference_date <- as.Date("2020-01-01")       # age is calculated on this date
sex_colours    <- c(Male = "steelblue", Female = "firebrick")

sex_keep <- NULL
age_min  <- NULL                   
age_max  <- 50    

diagnosis_icd_any <- NULL
diagnosis_icd_all <- NULL #c("^G43", "G444")
diagnosis_icd_exclude <- NULL

drug_atc_any <- "N02CC01" #c("N0AX02", "N02AA05")

custom_filter <- NULL # list(include_any("drug", column, "value"), exclude_any(...))
